info.title: OpenAPI-to-Go Generator Test Cases
info.description: A collection of atomic OpenAPI 3.0 Schema Objects representing different structural variations and data types to thoroughly test a Go struct generator.

OneOfPrimitives.description: Tests validation and code generation of a field that can be one of multiple primitive types (string or integer). This helps verify how the generator parses JSON values into dual-type or empty-interface containers in Go.

id_or_code.description: An identifier that can be either a string UUID/alphanumeric code or a 64-bit integer index.
